tools.name: honeycomb_query_service_map
tools.description: Queries service dependencies and relationships from distributed trace data with automatic polling and pagination. Use this to discover service-to-service call patterns, identify dependencies, visualize system architecture, or debug cross-service issues. Requires a time range specification (time_range in seconds, or start_time/end_time as Unix timestamps). Optional filters parameter allows narrowing to specific services by name. This tool performs create + poll + paginate operations automatically: creates async query, polls until ready, fetches all pages of results (up to 64K dependencies). Warning: Large time ranges may return thousands of dependencies across hundreds of API pages - use max_pages parameter to limit.

start_time.description: Absolute start time to evaluate dependencies, in seconds since UNIX epoch. Must be <= `end_time` (when `time_range` is not provided).
start_time.title: Start Time

end_time.description: Absolute end time to evaluate dependencies, in seconds since UNIX epoch. Must be >= `start_time` (when `time_range` is not provided).
end_time.title: End Time

time_range.description: Time range in seconds (minimum 1). Can be used with either `start_time` (seconds after `start_time`), `end_time` (seconds before `end_time`), or without either (seconds before now).
time_range.title: Time Range

filters.description: Optional list of service nodes to filter dependencies by. Only dependencies involving these nodes will be returned.
filters.title: Filters

max_pages.description: Maximum pages to fetch (default: 640, up to 64K results)

confidence.description: Claude's confidence level in this tool call. 'high' = certain this matches user intent and will succeed, 'medium' = likely correct but some uncertainty, 'low' = uncertain but best available option, 'none' = guessing or placeholder value.

notes.description: Structured reasoning notes explaining Claude's decision-making process. All categories are optional arrays of single-sentence strings.

decisions.description: Key decisions made (e.g., 'Chose COUNT over AVG for error rate')

concerns.description: Potential issues or risks (e.g., 'Time range may be too short')

assumptions.description: Assumptions being made (e.g., 'Assuming status_code column exists')

questions.description: Clarifying questions for increased confidence (e.g., 'I would be more confident if I knew the expected error baseline')

MapNode.description: A node in the service map (typically a service).

name.description: Name of the service or node.
name.title: Name

type.description: Type of the node. Currently only "service" is supported. Defaults to "service" if not specified.

MapNode.title: MapNode

MapNodeType.description: Type of the node. Currently only "service" is supported. Defaults to "service" if not specified.
MapNodeType.title: MapNodeType
